description: Robey Practices, Mindful 12 (final copy, July 2026). The reader asks themselves each question; the Korean word, its romanisation and its essence stay with the question in every language.

q.en: What small sign brings me back here, now?
q.fr: Quel petit signe me ramène ici, maintenant ?
q.ko: 지금 나를 다시 여기로 데려온 작은 신호는 무엇인가요?

q.en: After doing nothing for a while, what settled on its own inside me?
q.fr: Après un moment sans rien faire, qu’est-ce qui s’est apaisé en moi ?
q.ko: 가만히 있는 동안, 내 안에서 저절로 정리된 것은 무엇이었나요?

q.en: What could I remove so I can better see what I keep?
q.fr: Que puis-je retirer pour mieux voir ce que je garde ?
q.ko: 무엇을 덜어 내면, 남겨 둔 것이 더 잘 보일까요?

q.en: Was there a moment today when, even without spare time, my mind still felt unhurried?
q.fr: Y a-t-il eu aujourd’hui un moment où, même à court de temps, j’ai gardé un peu de marge en moi ?
q.ko: 오늘 시간이 없어도 마음만은 여유로울 수 있었던 순간이 있었나요?

e.en: moving with the flow, not forcing

q.en: Among the things I’m pushing right now, which would slide open if I found the direction it already moves?
q.fr: Parmi les choses que je pousse en ce moment, laquelle glisserait si je trouvais son sens ?
q.ko: 요즘 힘으로 밀고 있는 일 중에, 방향만 바꾸면 스르르 열릴 일은 무엇일까요?

q.en: Today, what have I been gripping without noticing?
q.fr: Aujourd’hui, qu’est-ce que je serrais sans même m’en rendre compte ?
q.ko: 오늘, 나도 모르게 꼭 쥐고 있던 것은 무엇일까요?

e.en: the whole mind gathered on one thing
e.fr: recueillir tout son cœur sur une seule chose

q.en: If I met the ordinary thing in front of me like an honored guest, what would change?
q.fr: Si je recevais la chose ordinaire qui est devant moi comme un hôte de marque, qu’est-ce qui changerait ?
q.ko: 지금 내 앞에 있는 평범한 일 하나를 귀한 손님처럼 대한다면, 무엇이 달라질까요?

e.en: letting words stop so you can hear yourself
e.fr: laisser les mots se taire pour s’entendre soi-même

q.en: Sometimes, what feeling am I trying to cover when I keep talking?
q.fr: Parfois, quel sentiment est-ce que je cherche à couvrir en parlant ?
q.ko: 나는 가끔 어떤 마음을 덮으려고 말을 할까요?

e.en: a clear mind that grasps at nothing
e.fr: un esprit clair qui ne s’accroche à rien

q.en: Was there something I saw more clearly precisely because I wasn’t trying to hold on to it?
q.fr: Y a-t-il quelque chose que j’ai mieux vu, justement parce que je ne cherchais pas à le retenir ?
q.ko: 붙잡으려 하지 않았더니 오히려 잘 보인 것이 있었나요?

e.en: a question that stays alive without an answer
e.fr: une question qui reste vivante sans réponse

q.en: What question would I keep close, even without finding its answer?
q.fr: Quelle question aimerais-je garder près de moi, même sans en trouver la réponse ?
q.ko: 답을 찾지 못해도 곁에 두고 싶은 질문은 무엇인가요?

e.en: the mind just as it always is
e.fr: le cœur tel qu’il est, depuis toujours

q.en: Of the things I’m searching for far away, what is already here?
q.fr: Parmi ce que je cherche au loin, qu’est-ce qui est déjà ici ?
q.ko: 내가 멀리서 찾고 있는 것 중에, 이미 여기 있는 것은 무엇일까요?
